physiology:
The traditions seat this code in the pineal, the small gland buried deep at the center of the brain, the one part of the body that responds directly to light and dark. It is no accident. This is the code of the pressure to know, the gland of mystery, set in the part of the head that older anatomies called the seat of the soul. It does its real work when the eyes are closed and the room is dark, releasing the chemistry of sleep, of dream, of the long inward turning the rest of the body cannot do while it is busy being awake.

The shadow has its floor here. When the mind grinds on the question and will not stop, the pressure registers as a heat behind the forehead, a sleep that will not settle, a tightness at the top of the head that no amount of thinking has been able to loosen. The lid the mind builds over the question is felt here first, as a steady low ache the body cannot quite name.

The climb out is also bodily. The head softens. Sleep becomes deep again. Dreams come back, and the dawn is met by a body that has rested somewhere the daylight could not reach. The wide silence the card promises is not only a state of mind. It begins in a gland the size of a grain of rice, in the dark at the center of the skull, in a body finally allowed to do its quiet work.
amino_acid:
Deeper than the gland, this code answers to isoleucine, an amino acid the body cannot make for itself and must take in from food. It belongs to the small branched-chain group, named for the angled side-arm that gives it its shape, and the body uses it to build muscle, to steady blood sugar through long effort, and to make the hemoglobin that carries oxygen through the dark interior of the blood.

There is a teaching folded into that. The code of mystery, of the pressure of why, is built on a molecule whose work is to keep the breath of the world moving deep inside the tissue. Isoleucine helps the body carry breath into places light will never reach. Inspiration in its oldest sense, filled with breath, written into the chemistry itself.

And like the others the body cannot make for itself, it must come in from outside. Even the chemistry of inner breath is received before it can do anything. The mystery is fed before it can be entered.
